subject: FP3 follow-up: W3.e still missing, swap Q6
body:
FR - Q8 swap looks clean, math verified. W2.e is now covered.

One remaining gap: W3.e (extraneous solutions) is still not tested in FP3. Q5 and Q6 are both W3.a — two questions on the same sub-standard when W3.e gets zero. W3.e will be on Tuesday's final.

Recommendation: replace Q6 (cube root solve, W3.a) with a W3.e extraneous solutions question. Something like sqrt(x+3) = x-3 where squaring produces an extraneous root that must be rejected on check.

Please update C:\Github\kai-algebra2-tests\data\finals-diagnostic-3.json and push to personal remote. Kai is on this exam now.

FA
